title: Add available clipboard actions for current content on Klipper plasma widget right-click menu
line: Right-clicking the Clipboard widget now offers Invoke Action, Show QR Code and Edit Contents for the current clipboard item.
explanation: The Clipboard widget's right-click menu only had Clear History and Configure Clipboard; the per-item actions (invoke action, QR code, edit) were only reachable as buttons on each entry inside the popup. The old standalone Klipper had these for the current item in its tray menu. The change adds Invoke Action, Show QR Code and Edit Contents… to the menu for the top history item, shown only when they apply (same rules as the entry's buttons). QR code and edit open the popup on that item's page; the history model exposes the current item's uuid, type and whether it has actions so the menu stays up to date.

commits.message:
applets/clipboard: add actions for the current item to the context menu

The widget's context menu could only clear the history, while each entry
in the popup can invoke an action, show a QR code or be edited. The menu
now offers these for the current clipboard item, opening the popup.

BUG: 415088

media.caption: Before: right-clicking the Clipboard widget with a URL copied only offers Clear History and Configure
After: the same menu also offers Invoke Action, Show QR Code and Edit Contents… for the current item
Show QR Code opens the popup on the current item's QR code
Invoke Action shows the actions for the copied URL
Edit Contents… opens the popup on the editor for the current item
